profile.ownerTitle: About me and the Maknemy project
profile.ownerP1: My name is Maksim, known online as Maknemy. I'm a Roblox creator, blogger and designer focused on Blox Fruits.
profile.ownerP2: I make news, update reviews, tier lists, guides, theories and material about the in-game economy and trading. My goal isn't just to report what's happening in the game, but to help players understand items, make better decisions and stay on top of everything that matters.
profile.ownerP3: Maknemy.com is my main project — an independent fan site for Blox Fruits players. It's built as one convenient place that brings together the tools and information players need most:
profile.ownerList3: values for fruits, permanent fruits, gamepasses, skins and mutations
profile.ownerList6: information about the game's economy and price changes
profile.ownerP4: The site helps players judge item values, check whether a trade is worth making, and track how the economy shifts after updates. The project grows alongside the game and is built first and foremost for the Russian-speaking community and players from the CIS.
profile.ownerP5: My goal is to make maknemy.com the most useful and convenient Blox Fruits fan project out there — a place players open before a trade, right after an update, or whenever they just need current information about the game.

home.faqSub: An independent fan site for Blox Fruits: handy tools, news and reference material.
home.faqA1p1: My name is Maksim, and online I go by Maknemy. I am a Roblox creator, blogger and designer: I make news, reviews, guides and other material about Blox Fruits.
home.faqA1p2: Maknemy.com is an independent fan project made first and foremost for the Russian-speaking community. It is not an official site of Roblox or of the Blox Fruits developers.
home.faqQ2: Why is the site called Maknemy?
home.faqA2p1: Maknemy is my nickname and the name of my own brand, which brings the site, the content and the community together. We are building a recognisable author's project through useful material and handy tools, without loud names that promise easy profit.
home.faqQ3: What can you find on the site?
home.faqA3p1: An item tier list, a trade calculator, trade listings, news and reference information on fruits, permanent fruits, gamepasses, skins and mutations.
home.faqA3p2: All of it is made with players in mind: to make it easier to find what you need, compare items and keep up with changes in the game.
home.faqQ4: How should the item values be read?
home.faqA4p1: The values in the tier list are rough estimates based on what we see in trades, demand, how available items are and offers from the community. They can change after updates and as players' interest shifts.
home.faqA4p2: Our job is to reflect what is happening in trades, not to steer the economy or set binding trade terms. Players decide for themselves which offers suit them.
home.faqA4p3: The values and calculations are not official prices and do not guarantee a profitable or successful trade. The information may contain inaccuracies and may be updated with a delay.
home.faqQ5: What should you keep in mind when trading?
home.faqA5p1: Check the items and terms in the in-game trade window. Never give anyone your password, confirmation codes or account cookies, including for an “item check” or to claim a prize.
home.faqA5p2: The site's tools help you compare offers, but they cannot vouch for the honesty of the other player.
home.faqQ6: Why are there ads on the site?
home.faqA6p1: Ads for other projects are one of the ways maknemy.com earns money and keeps growing.
home.faqA6p2: When choosing advertisers, we follow the Roblox rules and turn down projects that offer to break them: for example, selling accounts, unofficial sales of Robux or in-game items for real money, cheats or scam services.
home.faqA6p3: An ad on the site does not mean the project is endorsed by Roblox or the Blox Fruits developers.
home.faqQ7: Can you win prizes for free?
home.faqA7p1: Yes. The site runs giveaways where you can win prizes for free. No purchases or entry fees are required.
home.faqA7p2: The prizes, terms, dates, how winners are picked and how rewards are handed out are given in the announcement of each giveaway. Taking part gives you a chance to win but does not guarantee a prize.
home.faqA8p1: Next up is a full Blox Fruits wiki with detailed information on items, abilities and game mechanics, a clear structure and easy navigation.
home.faqA8p2: We also plan to improve the existing tools, the news and how information is found, while keeping the project's main goal: convenience and real use for players.

ads.001: Advertising on maknemy.com and in Telegram
ads.002: Promote a giveaway, channel or project to Blox Fruits players. Maknemy offers placements from a single day, ads for a week or a month, pay-per-click and giveaway participant campaigns.
ads.003: A small budget works too: an ad insert or a giveaway card costs from $2, and giveaway promotion paid by results is $36 per 1 000 participants.
ads.004: maknemy.com gets about 30 000 page views a day across the site. The tier list is the most visited page. Traffic varies; page views are not the same as unique visitors or impressions of a particular ad.
ads.006: Discuss a placement: telegram @maknemy.
ads.020: Want to bring people to your giveaway? We'll promote it on maknemy.com. Your social accounts can also be added to the conditions of a partner giveaway by agreement.
ads.021: 1 000 confirmed participants — $36.
ads.022: 2 000 confirmed participants — $72.
ads.023: A site visitor goes to the giveaway, completes the agreed conditions and confirms their entry. We agree on the required social accounts and how entries are checked before payment.
ads.025: The participant came through our campaign link.
ads.026: They enter this giveaway for the first time and have met the verifiable conditions.
ads.027: Each account counts once per order. Repeat sign-ups and detected fake entries are excluded.
ads.028: The required conditions are checked when the results are drawn.
ads.029: These are giveaway participants: their number can differ from the number of new followers on each social network, because some people may already follow you. Conditions tied to other platforms are covered by the guarantee only if they can be checked properly and comply with those platforms' rules.
ads.030: We agree in advance on the collection period, how entries are counted, the organiser and who is responsible for handing out prizes. $36 is the cost of promotion; prize costs are agreed separately.
ads.031: Results are drawn on the announced date. If the agreed volume is not reached by the end of the agreed period, we refund the unfulfilled part in proportion to the missing participants. By separate agreement, the remainder can be carried over to the next campaign. Staying subscribed and further activity after the giveaway are not covered by the guarantee.
ads.033: A card with a picture of the prize, short conditions, the deadline and a button leading to the giveaway. Shown on computers and phones in the partner giveaways block.
ads.041: On the tier list you can also book 30 days for $70 — about $2.33 a day. Weekly and other long placements are priced separately.

ads.131: Suitable content. We don't place scams, phishing, fake engagement, cheats and exploits, account sales, unofficial sales of in-game items and currency for real money, gambling or 18+ content. Every placement is reviewed in advance.
ads.132: Fair giveaways. The conditions must state real prizes, the required actions, the results date, how winners are picked and how prizes are delivered. We agree on who is responsible for prizes before launch. The organiser confirms the results and prize delivery.
ads.133: Clear guarantees. Time-based placement, clicks and confirmed participants are different services. A guarantee applies only to the metric stated in the order. Return on investment, sales and further audience activity are not promised.
ads.134: Shortfalls and refunds. For participants, the cost of the missing volume is refunded; for clicks, the unused budget. Carrying the remainder over to another campaign is possible by agreement. Terms for cancelling or moving a time-based placement are fixed before payment.
ads.135: Technical downtime. If a placement is unavailable through our fault, we make up for the time with an extension or a refund for the undelivered period, by agreement.
ads.136: Display terms and exclusivity. Pages, ad slots, rotation and restrictions for competitors are fixed at booking. Exclusivity applies only when agreed separately.
ads.138: Message @mksvtn and send a link to the project, the goal of the ad, the budget and the dates you want. We'll pick a format and confirm free slots.
